briefing.headline: OpenAI Orion and xAI Colossus accelerate AGI timelines as US-China chip curbs tighten

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs race toward multimodal superintelligence while regulatory fragmentation grows. Compute bottlenecks and talent wars intensify between US, China, and Gulf states.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI's Orion-2 scores 92% on GPQA Diamond; Anthropic releases Claude 4 Opus with extended context; Google Gemini 3 and Meta Llama 4 enter public preview; DeepSeek-V3 open weights spark new forks.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New NIST guidelines target agentic workflows.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC Arizona fab ships first 2nm wafers to NVIDIA; Microsoft and Oracle announce 50GW joint data center expansion in Texas and UAE.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first self-improving agentic system trigger an intelligence explosion before 2028?
